reason: The hypothesis relies on general HEA concepts (synergistic effects, electronic structure tuning) mentioned in E2 and E3, but no cited evidence specifically demonstrates controlled synthesis tailoring local electronic structure for ethanol oxidation, nor does any evidence link such tailoring to modulated intermediate adsorption energies in this reaction. E1 discusses N-doping effects on ORR, not ethanol oxidation, and E4/E5 are about ORR on different catalysts, providing no direct support for the key premises.
